## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. SPARTAN LTI — PT Lautan Teduh Interniaga
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap, PhpSpreadsheet, DomPDF
- **Description:** Enterprise Sparepart Inventory & Distribution Management System managing multi-tier warehouse operations, stock forecasting, invoicing, and real-time dealer supply chain across Lampung.
- **Impact:** Digitized and automated 6 core inventory workflows, reducing sparepart requisition turnaround time from 3 days to under 15 minutes.

### 2. SIGAP — Sistem Informasi Surat & Arsip Digital
- **Role:** Lead Developer
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap, PhpSpreadsheet, DomPDF
- **Description:** Official Digital Document Archiving & Dynamic Template Generation System for HIMAKOM Universitas Lampung.
- **Impact:** Automated official certificate and letter generation with variable placeholder injection, managing over 500+ student administrative files.

### 3. QMSERVICE — PT Lautan Teduh Interniaga
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap, BroadcastChannel API
- **Description:** Real-Time Workshop Queue & Mechanic Allocation Display System for Yamaha authorized service centers.
- **Impact:** Enabled sub-second multi-screen sync via BroadcastChannel API across service advisory desks and customer waiting lounges without websocket server overhead.

### 4. DreamRide — PT Lautan Teduh Interniaga
- **Role:** Full-Stack Web Developer
- **Live URL:** https://dreamride.lautanteduh.co.id
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, MySQL, Prisma ORM, Framer Motion, JWT (jose)
- **Description:** Interactive smart motorcycle recommendation engine matching prospective buyers with their ideal Yamaha vehicle based on budget, lifestyle, ergonomics, transmission type, and daily commute needs.
- **Highlights & Impact:** Multi-stage AI thinking loading screen (4 visual analysis stages & real-time 0%–100% progress), dual-tier recommendation engine (`scoring.ts` combining hard filter elimination and soft weight scoring with smart fallback ranking to guarantee non-empty results), and a secure admin management portal protected by HTTP-only JWT cookies, bcrypt, and rate limiting.

### 5. Sistem Pengundian Doorprize Yamaha
- **Role:** Frontend & Animation Developer
- **Tech Stack:** HTML5 Canvas, Vanilla JavaScript, CSS3 Animations, Web Audio API
- **Description:** Enterprise Digital Lucky Draw & Stage Lottery System used at regional Yamaha corporate gathering events for live audience engagement.
- **Impact:** Zero-lag randomized number generation with deterministic fraud prevention and high-framerate visual celebratory effects.
